decisions.reason: As a flagship launch directly aligned with the firm's cloud-based enterprise messaging strategy, transactional email remains strategically important and is unlikely to be withdrawn unless absorbed into a broader platform offer.

Email and fax conversion still fits the firm's multichannel, compliance-oriented customer base, but its legacy character makes it more exposed to medium-term portfolio simplification than the core cloud services.

A narrow fax optimization feature is the most vulnerable to rationalization in 2022 because it is less differentiated, less central to future growth, and easier to replace with broader platform capabilities.

Multi-engine email virus scanning continues to support the firm's secure managed messaging proposition, though evolving security stacks create some risk that it could later be consolidated into other protection services.
